title: Hilltop Landscape Maintenance District Engineer's Report
screening_status: Screened - categorical proximity weighting; no continuous decay
notes: Official city PDF; screen benefit-zone definitions, distance measures, assessment factors, and parcel roll.
methodology_finding: Zone 1 has a map-defined inner-circle subgroup; the report allocates a portion of Hilltop Mall parking-lot area to parcels inside the circle by parcel area. Other shares use acreage and zone-specific unit factors. This is categorical spatial weighting, not a continuous distance-decay curve.
decay_function: Binary inner-circle membership for one Zone 1 weighting component; no linear, exponential, or other continuous distance function stated. Circle radius is not specified in the method text (map referenced).
formula_or_weighting: Zone 1: weighted area units for inner-circle parcels, including prorated mall parking-lot area by parcel area; remaining parcels receive 1.00 area unit per acre; parcel assessment = zone net cost per AU x parcel AU. Zone 2 uses area plus 1.00 benefit unit per detached SFR and 0.60 per cluster home; Zone 3 is per acre. General-benefit percentages are cost-side deductions, not a parcel distance-decay factor.
evidence_location: FY 2024-25 Preliminary Engineer's Report, printed pp. 30-32 (PDF pp. 32-34), calculation steps; district diagram/map in Section VII.

title: Downtown Landscape Maintenance District Final Engineer's Report
screening_status: Screened - FY 2026-27 final report text inspected
notes: Final report adopted with Resolution 26-31 on May 26, 2026; City Council minutes confirm adoption.
methodology_finding: Four benefit zones allocate cost for Todos Santos Plaza, streetscape landscaping, collector-street medians, and thoroughfare medians. Plaza costs: nonresidential parcels by parcel area, residential parcels by unit count. Streetscape costs: parcel frontage. Each median zone allocates one-third by qualifying frontage and two-thirds by parcel area.
decay_function: No continuous distance-decay function. Adjacent/nearby improvements are reflected in categorical benefit zones and frontage-based apportionment, not a continuous distance variable.
formula_or_weighting: FY 2026-27 zone rates: Todos Santos Plaza $0.066582 per nonresidential parcel sq. ft. and $20.227564 per residential unit; Streetscape $2.019385 per frontage linear foot; Collector Street Median $0.573620 per qualifying frontage linear foot plus $0.003344 per parcel sq. ft.; Thoroughfare Median $1.418458 per qualifying frontage linear foot plus $0.003371 per parcel sq. ft. Total proposed assessment $519,152.18. Rates increased 1.75% under the voter-approved CPI escalator, capped at 5%.
evidence_location: Final Engineer's Report, Part D, printed pp. 14-17 (PDF pp. 18-21), zone allocation and rate calculations; Part E printed p. 18 (PDF p. 22), total assessment. Adopted May 26, 2026; Resolution 26-31.

title: Citywide Street Lighting Assessment District Final Engineer's Report
screening_status: Screened - FY 2026-27 final report text inspected
notes: Final report adopted with Resolution 26-34 on May 26, 2026; City Council minutes confirm adoption.
methodology_finding: Parcel charge equals the assigned Equivalent Dwelling Units (EDUs) multiplied by $25 per EDU. EDU factors classify relative benefit based on illumination intensity, pedestrian activity, and security; a single-family parcel is the 1.00-EDU baseline.
decay_function: No continuous distance-decay function. Adjacent illumination is one stated factor in assigning land-use EDU categories; parcel distance is not measured in the rate formula.
formula_or_weighting: FY 2026-27 rate is $25 per EDU; examples include 1.00 EDU ($25) per single-family parcel, 0.50 ($12.50) per condominium or vacant single-family parcel, 3.25 ($81.25) for a four-unit apartment example, 3 EDU ($75) for an office building example, and 20 EDU ($500) for a shopping center or industrial example. Detailed EDU schedule varies by land-use classification. Total proposed assessment $1,046,853.92; no rate increase proposed for FY 2026-27.
evidence_location: Final Engineer's Report, Part D, printed pp. 11-12 (PDF pp. 15-16), typical rates; Appendix A, printed p. 13 (PDF p. 17), EDU classification schedule; Part E printed p. 12 (PDF p. 16), total assessment. Adopted May 26, 2026; Resolution 26-34.
